grh_74ef015ed9497e9302c4.title: Words at War 43-08-19 (09) Last Days of Sevastopol
paragraphs: A repeat broadcast of the dramatization of Boris Voyetekhov's The Last Days of Sevastopol follows a Soviet correspondent through the besieged city during its final defense against German forces. He encounters ruined neighborhoods, wounded civilians, young reconnaissance helpers, mine layers and exhausted artillery crews continuing to fight under relentless attack. The recording culminates in the battles of late June and July 1942 as Sevastopol is reduced to rubble, preserving the defenders' endurance even as defeat becomes unavoidable.

This [[show|words-at-war|Words at War]] broadcast aired on August 19, 1943. It is listed as episode 9 in the archive. [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Martin Wolfson, Stefan Schnabel, Olive Deering, Charlotte Holland, and Hester Sondergaard. Other credited names include Joseph Losey as director and Richard McDonagh as radio adaptor.
The surviving recording runs about 31 minutes.
This version dramatizes [[work|work.words.91fa7bd1dfa31c97|Last Days of Sevastopol]]. Boris Voitikov is credited as author and Richard McDonagh adapted it for radio.

grh_74a5ecf4757a3fb3f466.title: The Milky Way
paragraphs: Mild-mannered milkman Burleigh Sullivan accidentally proves he can handle himself against middleweight champion Speed McFarland, inspiring manager Gabby Sloan to turn the reluctant milkman into a boxing attraction.
